research_question: After observing the #285 exploratory replication, do independent sources support the observed maturity-volatility and seasonal term-structure directions?
search_scope: Post-result triangulation of the two observed development phenomena without changing the executed construction or promoting development evidence to confirmation.

sources.title: Seasonality in commodity prices: new approaches for pricing plain vanilla options

claim_map.claim: Independent Henry Hub evidence describes the Samuelson effect as variation increasing as expiration approaches.
Independent exchange evidence describes winter natural-gas futures premia and summer/injection-season contango as seasonal term-structure features.

expected_observations: A literature-consistent replication should retain greater nearby than distant futures volatility.
A literature-consistent curve should show winter delivery prices systematically above warmer/injection-season delivery prices after removing same-date curve level.
disconfirming_observations: The observed maturity ordering is inconsistent with independent descriptions of the Samuelson effect.
The observed seasonal curve direction conflicts with the exchange-described winter premium.
